text: You had 202 orders today, 5 more than the 197 we expected, and brought in $4,528.00. The one problem was Jasmine rice, which ran out at 7:15pm. Food cost was $1,255.86 (27.7%) and labor was $860.00 (19%). All three payouts (DoorDash, appB and direct) matched what we expected, and there were no flagged invoices, price changes or driver delays. Pad Thai led with 96 sold, and Thai Iced Tea was the slowest at 29.
recommendations: Order extra Jasmine rice before the next Saturday, since Saturday is your busiest day at an average of 185 orders and rice ran out early tonight.
Check the home-game schedule for upcoming Saturdays and stock up more on rice and Pad Thai ingredients, because home-game Saturday evenings ran 33% busier than normal Saturdays.
Before the dinner rush, make sure the rice count is right and tell the kitchen to flag it early if it gets low.
